description: A Minecraft mod that overhauls the Command Block UI and text editor. Supports importing/exporting .pvic presets with custom icons and quick coordinate copying (Alt+C).

mods.name: Lovic's Better Command Block
mods.description: Enhances the command block GUI with a multiline editor, syntax highlighting, presets (.pvic), custom names, in-hand editing, and Alt+C block coordinate copy.
